summary: Ultra Clean Holdings filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $400 million of common stock under a sales agreement with UBS, Barclays, Craig-Hallum, and Oppenheimer. Shares may be sold at prevailing market prices on Nasdaq, with commissions up to 3.0%. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes and potential acquisitions, though none are planned. This is a routine capital-raising filing, not a special situation.
